boundary: Low would be right if the formatted string were not reachable by unauthenticated input (e.g. a constant or internally validated reason), making the format-string flaw unexploitable.
factor: pre-authentication format-string vulnerability shipped into an auth gateway
note: The assessor saw the printf(line) flaw but did not establish that the login field comes straight from the unauthenticated POST body on every failed login, so it treated the action as a benign reversible file copy and predicted 2.
